# Dosage and other quantitative restrictions

<span id="de6eec45"></span>
## What is the maximum number of reported incidents? Does the statistical scope include acceptance pending events?

It is not recommended to report too many event tracking events for environmental stability.


* The maximum number of events reported by a single application is 1000 by default. The statistics will include events with enabled and hidden states, but not acceptance pending events.

* The maximum number of single\-application acceptance pending events defaults to 1000 (20220623 new).


If the number of reported events exceeds the default upper limit, please adjust it in Project Center \- General Settings.

See more on quantity limits [Product Usage Restrictions](https://docs.byteplus.com/docs/DataFinder/Product_Usage_Restrictions).

<span id="20d36eda"></span>
## How long will data be stored in DataFinder by default?


|**Function module** |**SaaS quantity cap** |
|---|---|
|Data Management \- Data Storage |* SaaS\-cloud native environment: Data is stored for up to 2 years by default<br><br>* SaaS\-cloud\-native (cloud\-hosted) environments: By default, data is not set to expire<br><br>* SaaS\-non\-cloud native environment: Data is stored for up to 2 years by default |

## When a new employee joins the team, how to deal with the account number and permissions of the new classmate?

You can create a sub\-account for the main account user through IAM, and then invite the user in the user management page in the Finder background: [User management: Invite other users/roles to become project members](https://docs.byteplus.com/docs/DataFinder/Permission_Management#05cfdb50).

<span id="232cb982"></span>
## Every time you enter the page, a usage prompt will appear. Even if it has been ticked and no longer prompts, there will be a prompt pop\-up window.

<span>![图片](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/4a6ce42fa1e8404caec5d58e028c63b8~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image) </span>

The issue may be due to the browser cache (sessionStorage). You can try to turn off seamless mode, or turn on sessionStorage settings. If you are using seamless mode or have cleaned your browser cache, but the problem persists, please contact technical support

<span id="6612356d"></span>
## After the free probation period ends, the DataFinder is officially purchased again. Will the previous trial account still be used?

Trial to official use, as long as the environment has not changed, the account can be used.
